title.purpose: Feature and journey item titles — serif, never uppercase.

kicker.purpose: Gold serif-italic section lead-in; the brand's one flourish. Text Gold (#82612B) on light fields.

logotype.purpose: The 30px italic footer brand mark; display size, off the body ramp by design.

label.purpose: Buttons, nav, and text links only — uppercase tracked Gotham.

shadows.name: float
shadows.purpose: True floaters only — the story play button.

motion.name: ease-reveal
motion.purpose: Scroll reveals: rise 22px + fade, staggered via --rd delay.

motion.name: ease-image
motion.purpose: Imagery: blur-condense reveals and hover scale (0.7-1.1s).

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The ink pill — hero CTA and form submit.
components.css: .ds-btn-ink { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; font-family: Gotham, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.22em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #fff; background: #0e2338; border: 1px solid #0e2338; border-radius: 999px; padding: 15px 28px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.25s ease, transform 0.25s ease; } .ds-btn-ink:hover { background: #0a1d33; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-ink:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #a8813f; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: White pill with hairline; hover answers in gold.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; font-family: Gotham, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.22em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #0e2338; background: #fff; border: 1px solid rgba(14,35,56,0.12); border-radius: 999px; padding: 15px 28px; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(14,35,56,0.05); transition: border-color 0.25s ease, transform 0.25s ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { border-color: #a8813f; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #a8813f; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Email Field
components.description: Waitlist capture — white pill, gold focus ring.
components.css: .ds-input { font-family: Gotham, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 300; color: #0e2338; background: #fff; border: 1px solid rgba(14,35,56,0.12); border-radius: 999px; padding: 16px 26px; outline: none; min-width: 280px; transition: border-color 0.25s ease, box-shadow 0.25s ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #4d5c6a; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #a8813f; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(168,129,63,0.14); }

components.name: Nav Link
components.description: Header navigation — uppercase tracked, gold underline on hover.
components.css: .ds-nav-link { font-family: Gotham, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 10.5px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.22em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #0e2338; text-decoration: none; padding: 6px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid transparent; transition: color 0.25s ease, border-color 0.25s ease; } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: #a8813f; border-bottom-color: #a8813f; }

components.name: Kicker
components.description: The signature gold serif-italic section lead-in.
components.css: .ds-kicker { font-family: Tinos, 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-style: italic; font-size: 17px; letter-spacing: 0.02em; color: #82612b; margin: 0; }

components.name: Text Link
components.description: Uppercase tracked link with sliding arrow.
components.html: Learn More
components.css: .ds-textlink { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; font-family: Gotham, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.24em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #0e2338; text-decoration: none; transition: color 0.25s ease; } .ds-textlink:hover { color: #a8813f; } .ds-textlink-arrow { transition: transform 0.25s ease; } .ds-textlink:hover .ds-textlink-arrow { transform: translateX(5px); }

components.name: Journey Item
components.description: Frameless image + caption stack with italic gold number — the no-card card.
components.css: .ds-journey { margin: 0; width: 200px; } .ds-journey-img { display: block; aspect-ratio: 1; border-radius: 16px; border: 1px solid rgba(14,35,56,0.12); background: linear-gradient(160deg, #f4f5f6, #dde1e4); } .ds-journey-num { display: block; margin: 16px 0 4px; font-family: Tinos, 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-style: italic; font-size: 14px; color: #82612b; } .ds-journey-title { font-family: Tinos, 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 19px; color: #0e2338; margin-bottom: 6px; } .ds-journey-copy { font-family: Gotham, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13.5px; line-height: 1.65; font-weight: 300; color: #4d5c6a; margin: 0; }

narrative.overview: The page is a near-white gallery at altitude. Whisper-gray monochrome illustrations — mountains, valleys, a single falling drop — sit frameless in fields of their own tone, so the artwork and the page share one atmosphere rather than being pictures in boxes. Negative space is the primary material; brand navy ink and a rare gold flourish are the only voices that speak above the silence. Sophistication comes from restraint executed precisely, never from ornament.
keyCharacteristics: Near-white monochrome canvas; artwork blends into the page
Serif-led hierarchy (Tinos/Times) with Gotham for quiet utility text
One recurring flourish: the gold serif-italic kicker
Flat surfaces, hairline borders, tonal section fields
Vast, varied section spacing — the page breathes like thin air

rules.name: The One Gold Rule
rules.body: Gold speaks in exactly one voice: the serif-italic text family (kicker, journey numbers, status notes — one visual system). Icons and other graphics stay ink; if a second gold system appears in a fold, demote it to ink. Text gold on light fields is always Text Gold (#82612B), never Himalayan Gold.

rules.name: The Field-Match Rule
rules.body: Any full-bleed artwork sits on a section background sampled from the artwork's own field, so crops and overflow are invisible.

rules.name: The Serif-Speaks Rule
rules.body: Anything expressive is serif; Gotham is reserved for utility (body, labels, nav). If a heading is set in Gotham, it's wrong.

rules.name: The Flat-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: If an element isn't floating above the page in z-space (play button, fixed header), it gets a hairline, not a shadow.

dos: Do blend artwork into the page: match section backgrounds to the image's own field (#F4F5F6, #E9EBED) and keep images frameless behind a 1px hairline.
Do keep gold under 10% of any viewport — the serif-italic text voice only, with Text Gold (#82612B) whenever gold is text on a light field.
Do use serif for every expressive moment and reserve Gotham for utility text.
Do honor prefers-reduced-motion with instant alternatives for the intro, reveals, and smooth scroll.
Do hold body text at Stone (#4D5C6A) or darker — AA contrast is the floor.
donts: Don't drift toward mass-market water brands — no loud labels, badges, price flashes, or shelf-shouting compositions.
Don't borrow sporty energy branding: no splashy action shots, aggressive saturation, or dynamic slants.
Don't build generic startup-landing-page furniture: no gradient blobs, identical icon-card grids, hero-metric rows, or stock people.
Don't indulge luxury clichés: no gold foil textures, black-and-gold drenches, or ornate serif excess — if gold covers more than an accent, it's costume.
Don't put shadows on resting surfaces or colored side-stripe borders on anything.
Don't use cream/beige warmth — the cold is the brand; neutrals stay cool.
